description: This file defines the AWS\IotDataPlane\IotDataPlaneClient class, which is a client to interact with AWS IoT Data Plane service, including methods for managing thing shadows and messages.

classes.name: IotDataPlaneClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS IoT Data Plane, providing methods to interact with the IoT Shadow service.

methods.name: deleteThingShadow
methods.description: Deletes the shadow of a thing in AWS IoT.

methods.name: deleteThingShadowAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the shadow of a thing.

methods.name: getRetainedMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a retained message from AWS IoT.

methods.name: getThingShadow
methods.description: Retrieves the shadow document of an IoT thing.

methods.name: listNamedShadowsForThing
methods.description: Lists all named shadows associated with a thing.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to a topic.

methods.name: updateThingShadow
methods.description: Updates the shadow of a thing.
